rolloutOrder: requires:sat-engine release (claude/sat-engine: question_spr grading, KaTeX rendering, official-domain filters) merged, Pages deployed and the sat-practice function deployed first
manualFollowUps: Order: ship the sat-engine release first (or in the same window, engine first). This migration publishes 58 grid-in items of type question_spr and LaTeX ($...$) prompts; the currently deployed SAT Practice app and function cannot grade question_spr or render KaTeX, and select_sat_practice_questions serves every published question_% row, so pushing this before the engine would show learners raw LaTeX and ungradable grid-ins.

Database: supabase db push --linked --include-all only from an isolated copy of the installed migrations plus 20261026140000_sat_practice_algebra_advanced_math.sql (and whatever sat-engine migrations ship with it), keeping the 9 pending payment migrations from #220 (20261010162000-20261010174000) excluded. Dry run first, then supabase migration list --linked. Adds 2 parts under the SAT Practice Math section (Algebra display_order 10, Advanced Math display_order 11) and 220 original questions (110 Algebra, 110 Advanced Math; 162 question_single_choice, 58 question_spr) with answer keys. Idempotent: every insert is on conflict do nothing, ids are md5('schood-sat-part:'||domain) and md5('schood-sat-q:'||slug).

Source of truth: content/sat-practice/algebra.json and content/sat-practice/advanced_math.json. To change content, edit the JSON, run node scripts/content/validate-sat-practice.mjs content/sat-practice/*.json, then node scripts/content/sat-math-a.mjs and ship a new migration (this one never updates existing rows).
No Pages, Edge Function, worker or secret changes in this release.
verification: supabase migration list --linked shows 20261026140000 applied and the 9 #220 payment migrations still pending; the push log prints the notice 'SAT Practice Algebra/Advanced Math questions present: 220 of 220'.

select u.metadata->>'sat_official_domain' d, u.type, count(*) from public.content_units u join public.parts p on p.id=u.part_id where p.section_id='bee41358-7368-5bbb-bb76-e42afe3c1c44' and u.metadata->>'content_revision'='original-2026-10-v2' and u.metadata->>'sat_official_domain' in ('algebra','advanced_math') group by 1,2 returns algebra/question_single_choice 82, algebra/question_spr 28, advanced_math/question_single_choice 80, advanced_math/question_spr 30; every one of those rows has an answer_keys row.

As a signed-in SAT Practice learner: a Math set filtered to Algebra or Advanced Math shows the new questions with rendered math, the seven graph items show their figure, the four table items show their table, and a grid-in item (e.g. original_slug alg-lin2v-018, accepted 32/3, 10.66, 10.67) grades 32/3 and 10.67 as correct and 10.6 as incorrect.

rollback.migration: Do not delete (learner attempts may reference the rows). Retire instead: update public.content_units set metadata = metadata || '{"content_status":"retired","retired_in":"sat-practice-algebra-advanced-math-content"}'::jsonb where metadata->>'content_revision'='original-2026-10-v2' and metadata->>'sat_official_domain' in ('algebra','advanced_math'); select_sat_practice_questions skips retired rows.
